description_en: Uploads the private key corresponding to a CSR if you did not provide the CSR private key when uploading the local CSR
description_zh: 如果您在上传本地CSR时未传入CSR私钥，您可以通过该接口上传CSR对应的私钥
name: UpdateCsr

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the CSR. The CsrId is generated when you upload the CSR. You can obtain this value by querying the CSR list. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2709717.html
parameters.help_zh: CSR唯一标识。上传CSR时会生成CsrId。您可以通过查询CSR列表获取该值，接口详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2709717.html
parameters.name: csr_id

parameters.example: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- MII.... -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en: The certificate private key content in PEM format. This private key must match the public key cryptography contained in the CSR referenced by CsrId. Otherwise, the API returns the NotMatch.CsrAndPrivateKey error
parameters.help_zh: PEM格式的证书私钥内容。此私钥必须与 CsrId 所引用的 CSR 中包含的公钥密码学匹配，否则 API 将返回 NotMatch.CsrAndPrivateKey 错误
parameters.name: key

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
